fact: The Council of Ministers approved a draft decree on a National Digital Skills Policy whose purpose is to train Guinean citizens in digital skills, per the cabinet communique reported by ANG.
The Council of Ministers approved, with amendments, a draft decree on the National Digital Skills Policy, aimed at equipping national citizens with digital skills.

O Democrata GB reports the government and Telecel signed a memorandum on 23 April 2026 to launch the STARTOCODE learning platform, with the government committing to train 1,000 young people a year, 4,000 over four years, coordinated by the transport and digital economy ministry; no number trained is stated.
